conservative.read: This mode aims for low, steady growth around 1.5% per month. It significantly reduces risk by cutting leveraged positions and holding more cash. Drawdowns should be minimal, but upside potential is also capped.

plan: Trim leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to small percentages.
Trim METU to reduce AI/Software concentration.
Trim QQQI to 20% to reduce concentration.
Buy TZA (inverse ETF) for potential hedging.
This plan balances risk reduction with growth opportunities.
A moderate cash buffer is maintained.
balanced.read: This mode targets around 2.5% monthly growth with a risk-first approach. It reduces leverage and concentration while adding a small hedge. Upside is moderate, and drawdowns are expected to be controlled.

plan: Increase leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) to 6% each.
Increase METU to 6% to concentrate in AI/Software.

aggressive.read: This mode aims for aggressive growth around 4% per month, accepting higher risk. It significantly increases leverage and concentration in tech/semis, including leveraged ETFs. Expect amplified gains and larger potential drawdowns due to leverage and daily rebalancing of leveraged ETFs.

plan: Sell all leveraged ETFs (SOXL, SPAL, MUU, PLTU) and high-beta METU.
